signature.name: VTask.IsSaddlePointOn
signature.type: {E : Type u_1} -> {F : Type u_2} -> {β : Type u_3} -> (X : Set E) -> (Y : Set F) -> (f : E → F → β) -> [Preorder β] -> (a : E) -> (b : F) -> Prop

conventions.statement: The predicate VTask.IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a b does not require a ∈ X or b ∈ Y; it only asserts ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ Y, f a y ≤ f x b.
conventions.note: Explicitly stated in the docstring: 'we do not require that a ∈ X and b ∈ Y'.

conventions.statement: If X = ∅ or Y = ∅ then VTask.IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a b holds for all a, b, f by vacuous universal quantification.
conventions.note: Standard behaviour of ∀ over an empty set in Lean/Mathlib.

facts.statement: ∀ {E F β : Type*} [Preorder β] (X : Set E) (Y : Set F) (f : E → F → β) {a a' : E} {b b' : F}, a' ∈ X → b ∈ Y → VTask.IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a b → VTask.IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a' b' → VTask.IsSaddlePointOn X Y f a b'
